normalization.title: An Open Agent Still Needs an Operator
normalization.overview: Chase AI introduces n8n Nod, a single-owner open-source assistant with its own computer and browser.
normalization.whyItMatters: Owner-operated agents shift the burden of privacy, maintenance and trustworthy action onto the operator.
normalization.ghostMeshTakeaway: Evaluate exact-action authorization, credential boundaries, interruption recovery and independent outcome receipts in a synthetic-account sandbox before production use.

archiveCall.label: Ownership is not governance
